notes: The test suites use testcontainers, not the sandbox; the sandbox Postgres is for manual checks only. Testcontainers runs count against the workstation's heavy-workload cap. syslog (UDP and TCP) and syslog_tls serve the live syslog collector, started with --profile syslog after writing certificates with tests/syslogfwd/live/make_certs.py <sandbox>/certs. stub_idp serves the stub OIDC provider (mock-oauth2-server over TLS) for the live single sign-on check, started with --profile idp after writing its keystore with tests/identity/sso/live/make_certs.py <sandbox>/idp-certs; the live check also starts a testcontainers Postgres, so the stack plus the run count as two heavy workloads.
